_meta.description: T19 §18 golden AI regression set. Each item is an English source (headline+summary) plus a hand-written good/bad Telugu rendering used to exercise app/content/qa.py and app/content/glossary.py deterministically, without a live provider call. Every item here is hand-written and human-reviewed (ADR-013) -- see eval/README.md for the review process and how to grow this set.
_meta.provenance: All items are the original hand-written/human-reviewed corpus from the initial T19 ticket. A 270-item bulk-generated expansion existed briefly (2026-09-09 through 2026-09-16) but was never reviewed by a native Telugu speaker or editorial staff and has been removed per ADR-013 -- see docs/adr/ADR-013-golden-eval-set-trust-tier.md. Growing this set past 30 requires the same bar: native-Telugu-speaker review before an item is committed, not after.
